hero.title: Let AI safely read and manage your bookmark knowledge base
hero.description: Connect your collection to AI. With a Skill, API, or MCP, your Agent can find answers and organize bookmarks — with you in control of every write.

summary.scopeValue: Query, create, and organize bookmarks and tags

skill.title: Use MarkVault as an Agent Skill
skill.description: Copy this prompt to your coding Agent so it downloads the Skill, reference, and zero-dependency client with the correct directory structure.
skill.installPrompt: Install and use the MarkVault Skill from {{origin}}/markvault/SKILL.md. Also download agents/openai.yaml, references/api.md, and scripts/markvault-client.mjs using their relative paths. Reads may run directly. Before creating, updating, or deleting data, show me the exact action and obtain explicit confirmation. Read MARKVAULT_BASE_URL and MARKVAULT_API_KEY from local environment variables, and never ask me to paste the full key into the conversation.
skill.environmentDescription: Keep the key in the Agent's local runtime. Do not commit it or place it in chat history.

steps.keyDescription: Choose READ_ONLY, BASIC, or FULL for the intended use and grant write permissions only when needed.
steps.envDescription: Set the instance URL and API Key without putting the secret in CLI arguments or URLs.
steps.verifyDescription: Call me first to inspect permissions, and reconfirm every write before execution.

api.title: Stable read/write REST API
api.description: Use /api/v1/agent/* for long-lived integrations. The legacy /api/tab/* routes are not part of the public stable contract.

endpoints.me: Validate the key and read account stats
endpoints.search: Search bookmark fields and tag names
endpoints.bookmark: Read, update, or move a bookmark to trash
endpoints.tag: Read, update, or delete a tag

api.resourcesDescription: Provide these directly to Agents, API clients, or documentation generators.

mcp.title: Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP
mcp.description: MCP clients discover and call MarkVault capabilities through a standard tool protocol. The server hides tools that the current API Key cannot use.

items.transportDescription: Connect to {{origin}}/api/mcp with JSON or text/event-stream responses.
items.permissionDescription: tools/list returns only the read and write tools allowed by the current key.
items.confirmDescription: Every MCP write tool requires confirm=true after the user explicitly approves it.

mcp.toolsDescription: Covers account details, search, and bookmark/tag reads, creates, updates, soft deletion, and restoration. Bookmark deletion only moves items to trash.

security.title: Least privilege and human approval work together
security.description: Reads, external automation, and the in-app chat share one tool layer while API Key permissions and human approval independently protect writes.

items.permissionDescription: Create, update, delete, and tag assignment are checked separately; a READ_ONLY key cannot invoke writes.
items.leastPrivilegeTitle: Keys can expire or be revoked
items.leastPrivilegeDescription: Create one key per Agent, grant only required permissions, and retain rate limits and usage records.
items.mcpDescription: Even a write-enabled key is rejected unless an MCP write tool receives confirm=true.
items.chatDescription: The model produces a pending action and the UI shows its arguments. No database change occurs before approval.

security.boundaryDescription: Bookmark deletion is recoverable soft deletion. Permanent deletion, sharing settings, account settings, and arbitrary database actions are not exposed. Third-party model keys are encrypted with an instance-level secret.

chat.title: In-app Agent
chat.description: Search and organize bookmarks in natural language. Every write action waits for your confirmation.
chat.notConfiguredTitle: The in-app Agent is not configured
chat.notConfiguredDescription: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and enable the in-app Agent. The third-party secret is encrypted on this instance.
chat.safetyDescription: Reads can run immediately. Create, update, and delete actions produce a confirmation card and cannot change data without approval.
chat.welcomeTitle: I can help manage your bookmarks
chat.welcomeDescription: Search and summarize bookmarks, or create, update, and move them to trash. No write action runs until you confirm it.
examples: Create a tag named Read later
chat.destructiveHint: This changes data. Deleted bookmarks go to trash; deleting a tag removes its associations.
chat.confirmHint: This write action runs only after confirmation.
chat.placeholder: Ask a question or request an action…
chat.placeholderPending: Confirm or cancel the pending action first
chat.placeholderDisabled: Enable the in-app Agent in settings first
chat.inputHint: Press Enter to send or Shift + Enter for a new line. Write actions ask for separate confirmation.
chat.resolvePendingHint: Resolve the confirmation card above before continuing so stale actions cannot run.
